title: Group wrap: reject RFC 7748 small-order epk on unwrap; pin point-validation tests
description: Security review finding on worker6-9mkj.2. group_oscore_wrap.py:151-155,238 comment claims all-zero shared-secret rejection defends against small subgroup attack, but it only catches the order-1 identity point. A nonzero low-order epk (orders 2/4/8) yields a predictable shared secret, letting an attacker derive the KEK and craft AES-KW ciphertext unwrapping to a chosen group key (epk is attacker-supplied; X25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes does no validation). Exploit requires defeating pairwise-OSCORE delivery, so defense-in-depth. Fix: reject epk u-coordinates matching the 8 known RFC 7748 small-order values before exchange(), or correct the comment to state reliance on OSCORE-authenticated delivery. Also add tests: wrap_for_members rejects 32-byte non-Ed25519-point key (only wrong-length tested now), and unwrap behavior for nonzero low-order epk is pinned.
